name: Aerial Gleam
tagline: Height as a difficulty, and the prettiest thing this far down the list.

facts.note: Pointercrate credits Antares, Endlevel, Deadlox and Culuc; Baylor also credits El3cTr0, and that name is carried here on his say-so rather than from a source. Doggie verified it on 25 April 2022 after 21,896 attempts; it was rated on 14 May and entered the Demonlist at #13 on 11 June. The level's own description reads “fixed by doggie”, and the verification video listed on AREDL is dated 24 August 2022, so that is likely a later pass on the fixed version. Ranked #140 on the Demonlist as of 30 August 2026.

spotlight.eyebrow: Built, then fixed, then beaten by
spotlight.sub: Endlevel hosted it. The level's own description gives Doggie the fix as well as the verification.

voice.hook: The list gets prettier the further down you go.
voice.why:
Aerial Gleam is a 2.2 level that spends its whole runtime in the air. Endlevel hosted it with Antares, Deadlox and CuLuC, and the decoration leans into altitude rather than into hell — pale light, open space, and a sense of being a long way off the ground.

Doggie verified it, and the level's own description credits him with fixing it too. It sits at #140 on the Demonlist, which is further down than most of this list, and it is here on looks and feel rather than on difficulty.
